mapper.select: SELECT m.workspace_id, m.user_id, m.role, m.project_access_mode, m.company_name, m.job_title, m.created_at, u.display_name, u.username FROM workspace_member m JOIN app_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY CASE m.role WHEN 'owner' THEN 0 WHEN 'admin' THEN 1 WHEN 'member' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, u.display_name, u.id
SELECT user_id FROM workspace_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}

SELECT m.workspace_id, m.user_id, m.role, m.project_access_mode, m.company_name, m.job_title, m.created_at, u.display_name, u.username FROM workspace_member m LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND m.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND role = 'owner'

SELECT m.role, m.project_access_mode, r.owner_user_id AS projectOwnerUserId, pm.access FROM workspace_member m LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.workspace_id = m.workspace_id AND r.id = #{projectId} LEFT JOIN project_member pm ON pm.workspace_id = m.workspace_id AND pm.project_id = #{projectId} AND pm.user_id = m.user_id WHERE m.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND m.user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_member (workspace_id, user_id, role, project_access_mode) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{userId}, #{role}, COALESCE(#{projectAccessMode}, 'all'))
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace_member SET role = #{role} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE workspace_member SET project_access_mode = #{mode} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE workspace_member SET company_name = #{companyName} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE workspace_member SET job_title = #{jobTitle} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM workspace_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId}
